text: DSH Ecosystem Panel 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的只读生态状态面板。它在侧边栏设置按钮上方加入入口，并由服务端提供状态接口，汇总插件 bundle 与 patch insert、补丁特征、技能、升级和依赖解耦情况。用户可按标签查看各类状态、异常原因和数据新鲜度，也可手动刷新；过期数据会先显示并在后台更新。它适合需要集中检查 DSH profile 组件状态的维护者。升级检查会查询 npm registry，并将版本结果缓存到本机；补丁清单及外部诊断脚本需按需配置。

DSH Ecosystem Panel is a read-only status panel for DSH web. It adds a sidebar entry and groups plugin, patch, skill, upgrade, and decoupling checks by tab. View status and reasons, check freshness, and refresh. Stale results appear first. Upgrade checks query npm and cache versions.
想在 DSH 侧边栏集中查看插件和技能有没有异常。

想查看 npm 上依赖包的新版本并和本地版本对照。
I want one read-only dashboard for plugin, patch, and skill status in my DSH profile.

DSH Ecosystem Panel 的功能「生态状态总览」：在 Web 侧边栏打开面板，按标签查看 bundle、patch insert、补丁、技能、升级和解耦状态，并显示问题原因。
DSH Ecosystem Panel 的功能「插件与补丁检查」：读取 profile bundle、patch insert 及实体目录，并检查配置清单中的补丁特征；状态缺失或不可判定时显示原因。
DSH Ecosystem Panel 的功能「升级版本查看」：将 profile 中的依赖包与 npm registry 版本信息对照，使用本地缓存，并在面板展示外部只读分级结果。
DSH Ecosystem Panel 的功能「旧数据提示与刷新」：面板显示缓存数据的新鲜度；数据过期时先显示旧结果，再由后台请求更新，用户也可手动刷新。
DSH Ecosystem Panel 使用须知：升级检查会向 registry.npmjs.org 查询依赖包版本，并将结果写入本机缓存文件。（见 lib/upgrade.js:87-93、lib/upgrade.js:133-137）

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · dsh-ecosystem-panel：> ### 这是什么
> **一个只读的「生态体检」面板插件**：bundle / patch / skill / 升级 / 解耦，一屏看完。
>
> ### 它解决什么
> 装了十几个插件之后，"到底挂上了没、有没有重复挂、谁的补丁和谁打架"会变成玄学。这个面板只做一件事：把六类体检结果摊在一屏上，**全是只读**，不会替你改任何东西。首屏还有 SWR 与周期预热（旧值先出、不转圈），以及一页脚 SLI 告诉你"这屏数据多久之前采的"。
>
> ### 一条命令跑起来
> ```powershell
> dsh plugin --profile web add @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel
> ```
> 装完在侧边栏进入面板；不用改 `cordis.patch.yml`。
>
> ### 它长什么样
> 一屏六组卡片（每个插件一行状态 + 一句诊断理由），页脚一行采样时间与耗时。⚠️ 本仓**暂无截图**。

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · dsh-ecosystem-panel：> ### 它不附带什么（先看清楚，省得装完失望）
>
> 这套开源出来的是**能用的工具 + 装完自检 + 设计文档**。有两块**不在开源范围里**：
>
> 1. **「自己盯着活干」的那套引擎**：定时调度、队列盯守、管家日报、自主决定要不要动手 —— 这几件还没整理出来放（整理完会陆续放）。它的**设计本身是公开的**，写在 [`ops-handoff-design`](https://github.com/kira905/ops-handoff-design) 仓里，想自己实现的人照着做得到。
> 2. **「出事喊到人」的通道**：企业微信、语音播报这类 —— **不随开源发布**。
>
> 所以：装完你拿到的是一套**能用的工具**，不是一个会自己上班的管家。

---

> **本仓装完即用**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel` 一条命令，`dsh.bundle` 会让它自动挂进 profile 的组合列表，**不需要再手工写 `cordis.patch.yml`**。

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 1. 它看什么（六类 + 一个可选类）：| 类目 | 数据来源 | 判定 | 数据缺失时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① **bundle 插件** | profile 的 `package.json`（`dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`）+ 各包实体 `package.json` + 宿主首页的 boot 清单 | 实体在不在 / 声明版本与实体版本是否漂移 / 声明了 client 能力但 boot 里没加载 = 🔴 | boot 抓不到 ⇒ 显示「加载状态未知」（黄），**不当作已加载** |
| ② **patch insert 插件** | profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `insert` 条目 | 实体目录能否解析到（profile 层 → 共享 fallback 层）；被 `disabled` 的标黄 | YAML 解析器不可用 ⇒ 明说「不可解析」，不当成空清单 |
| ③ **补丁健康** | **你提供的补丁清单**（外置 JSON） | 逐条做特征串扫描：`contains` 缺一个 = 定制被冲掉（黄）；目标文件没了 = 🔴；`notContains` 命中 = 残留 | 清单没配 ⇒ 显示「未配置 ⇒ 不可判定」（黄），**不显示"0 个补丁"** |
| ④ **技能** | 数据根下 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter | 缺 `name` / `description`、frontmatter 解析失败 | 目录不存在 ⇒ 报 `skillsDirOk=false` |
| ⑤ **升级体检** | 本地实体版本 + npm registry 最新版（24h 文件缓存）+ 你的规则表文案 | 颜色由**外部只读 CLI** 判定；本面板只渲染（拿不到就显示「档位不可用」+ 原因，**绝不猜颜色**） | 没配 CLI ⇒ 每行 `unknown` + 原因 |
| ⑥ **解耦健康** | **你提供的外部检查脚本**（动态 import 复用其导出函数，不复制判定） | R1 静态 import 宿主符号 = 🔴；动态导入/依赖未归零 = 🟡 | 没配脚本 ⇒ 一条 🟡 + 配置指引 |
| ⑦ **跨表准入一致性**（可选） | **你提供的外部校验器** | 三态显式枚举 `ok / fail / unavailable`；`asOf` 缺失即判 `unavailable` | 没配 ⇒ `unavailable`（**不是** 0/0/0 绿） |

- 配置解析失败（比如清单 JSON 坏了）不会让面板崩：`meta.configErrors` 里能看到原因，该键回落默认。

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5. 界面：- 六类各占一张标签卡（Tab），Tab 上的小圆点 = 该类最差状态（红 > 黄 > 绿）
- 点「刷新」会重新取数；`GET /state?refresh=1` 强制重查 npm 最新版（否则 24h 缓存）；
  `GET /state?refresh=all` 整屏丢缓存重取（排障用，别日常按）
- 颜色：🟢 正常 / 🟡 风险或不可判定 / 🔴 异常（比如 patch insert 的实体缺失）
- 面板底部说明与标题可由配置覆盖（`text.title` / `text.note` / `text.tabs`，服务端经 `meta.ui` 下发）

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 首屏为什么不转圈（SWR / 周期预热 / 分片取数）：| 坏毛病 | 处方 | 你能看到什么 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 数据过期了就得干等刷新（转圈） | **SWR**：数据块自带 `fetchedAt`，过期判据 = `now - fetchedAt > 阈值`（缺省 **300 s**）；过期时**先把旧值渲染出去**，同时后台刷新，刷回来再替换 | 面板顶部一条「🕗 这是旧值：skills 旧了 320 s（后台正在换新，刷回来自动替换）」；页面不转圈 |
| ② 每次冷启动都从零算（慢） | **周期预热**：可配周期 + 三个环境变量口；**缺省关闭**，开了就先填一遍再按周期续 | 页脚「预热 开 · 300 s · 已跑 N 次」；关掉时页脚写「预热 关」 |
| ③ 某一个源挂了/超时，整页跟着废 | **分片 + 单飞 + 超时预算 + 局部降级**：源清单是参数化的、同一源同一时刻只有一次在途取数、每源一个超时 + 整页一个总预算；坏源**只坏那一格** | 那一格变成「不可探测：超时 / 报错 / 未配置 / 总预算耗尽」，其余照出，整页仍然 200 |
section: 5.1 首屏为什么不转圈（SWR / 周期预热 / 分片取数）

text:
@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 首屏为什么不转圈（SWR / 周期预热 / 分片取数）：**为什么阈值是 300 s**：复用体系里既有的五分钟节奏，**不新增定时作业** —— 出处是文档仓
《只读监控面板的设计纪律》**§3.2**（见「设计依据」节）。想改就改 `ttlMs`，但别在代码里另写一个数。

**为什么预热缺省关**：预热是"后台常驻"的动作，会替你花资源；默认替你决定不合适。开了以后
缺省只预热**纯本地的五源**（`boot / bundles / inserts / patches / skills`）——
`decoupling / upgrades / registry` 要跑外部脚本或查 npm，不进缺省预热（要就自己在
`DSH_ECOSYSTEM_PANEL_WARMUP_SOURCES` 里点名，或写 `*` 全预热）。

**冷启动不许返回空壳**：没有任何旧值时，这一次**阻塞取真值**，并单独记成 SLI 的 `coldMiss`
（不记的话"命中率"会把冷启动算成命中，读数就废了）。页脚的三桶永远是分开的：
`命中 12（70.6%）· 未命中 3 · 冷启 2`。

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 首屏为什么不转圈（SWR / 周期预热 / 分片取数）：**"预热生效"怎么证明**：不是看它跑没跑，而是**关掉它必须看得见冷窗**。夹具
`scripts/test-warmup-negctl.mjs` 就是这条阴性对照，读数形如：

```
场景         首屏耗时   首屏冷启动  源数
预热开         1 ms         0         10
预热关         159 ms       10        10
```

（开 = 全部命中缓存；关 = 首屏自己冷取 10 个源，其中那个 150 ms 的慢源躲不掉。）

**分片是参数化的**：新增数据源 = 在 `lib/state.js` 的源清单里加一条
（`{ id, label, group, deps, timeoutMs, run, describe }`），**装配主流程一行都不用改**；
下游插件也可以在运行时 `registerSource()` 把自己的健康片挂进这块面板（夹具里就是这么验的）。

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · dsh-ecosystem-panel：> ### What this is
> **A read-only ecosystem health panel plugin**: bundle / patch / skill / upgrade / decoupling, all in one view.
>
> ### What it solves
> With a dozen plugins installed, questions like "did it actually mount, is it mounted twice, whose patch is fighting whose" turn into folklore. This panel does exactly one thing: lay six kinds of diagnosis on a single screen, **all read-only** — it never changes anything for you. The first paint uses SWR plus periodic warm-up (show the old value immediately instead of spinning), and a footer SLI tells you how old the data is.
>
> ### Run it in one command
> ```powershell
> dsh plugin --profile web add @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel
> ```
> Then open the panel from the sidebar; no `cordis.patch.yml` editing.
>
> ### What it looks like
> Six card groups (one row per plugin with a one-line diagnosis) plus a footer with sample time and duration. ⚠️ **No screenshot yet.**

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 4.3 Degradation semantics (important)：- **Not configured ≠ absent**: with no manifest configured, ③ shows "not configured ⇒ cannot be judged" and never "0 patches, all green"; ⑥⑦ and ⑤ work the same way (each carries configuration guidance).
- **Cannot be fetched**: when the boot manifest cannot be fetched from the host home page, ① marks only the "unknown" as yellow and puts the raw fetch error into `meta.bootError`.
- **Disabled**: if a class is genuinely not needed, put it into `disabledGroups` — the panel then shows a "disabled by configuration" notice (clearer than silently disappearing, and not counted in the summary).
- A configuration parse failure (a broken manifest JSON, say) does not crash the panel: `meta.configErrors` carries the reason and that key falls back to its default.

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5. Interface：- Each of the six classes has its own tab; the small dot on a tab = the worst state of that class (red > yellow > green)
- Clicking "refresh" fetches the data again; `GET /state?refresh=1` forces a fresh lookup of the npm latest version (otherwise the 24 h cache is used); `GET /state?refresh=all` drops the whole cache and refetches (for troubleshooting, not for everyday clicks)
- Colours: green = healthy / yellow = at risk or not judgeable / red = abnormal (a missing patch insert entity, for instance)
- The panel's title and footer note can be overridden by configuration (`text.title` / `text.note` / `text.tabs`, delivered by the server through `meta.ui`)

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 Why the first screen does not spin (SWR / periodic warmup / sharded fetch)：| Failure mode | Remedy | What you see |
|---|---|---|
| ① Data goes stale and you have to sit through a spinner | **SWR**: every data block carries `fetchedAt`; "expired" means `now - fetchedAt > threshold` (default **300 s**). When expired, the **old value is rendered first** while a refresh runs in the background | A banner at the top: "🕗 This is a stale value: skills is 320 s old (refreshing in the background, it will replace itself)". No spinner |
| ② Every cold start computes from scratch (slow) | **Periodic warmup**: configurable period + three environment-variable ports; **off by default**; once on it primes immediately and then keeps the rhythm | Footer: "warmup on · 300 s · ran N times"; when off it says "warmup off" |
| ③ One slow or broken source wastes the whole page | **Sharding + single-flight + timeout budget + partial degradation**: the source list is parameterised, one source has at most one in-flight fetch at a time, each source has its own timeout plus a page-wide budget, and a bad source **only breaks its own cell** | That cell becomes "not probe

text: @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 Why the first screen does not spin (SWR / periodic warmup / sharded fetch)：**Why warmup is off by default**: warmup is a resident background activity that spends resources on your behalf, so it is not a decision to make for you. When enabled it primes only the **five purely local sources** (`boot / bundles / inserts / patches / skills`); `decoupling / upgrades / registry` run external scripts or query npm and are left out unless you name them (or pass `*` to warm everything).

text: @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 Why the first screen does not spin (SWR / periodic warmup / sharded fetch)：**A cold start must never return an empty shell**: with no old value at all, that request **blocks for the real value** and is recorded separately as `coldMiss` in the SLI (otherwise the hit rate would count cold starts as hits and the reading would be worthless). The footer always keeps the three buckets apart: `hit 12 (70.6%) · miss 3 · cold 2`.

text: @kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 5.1 Why the first screen does not spin (SWR / periodic warmup / sharded fetch)：**Sharding is parameterised**: adding a data source means adding one entry to the source list in `lib/state.js` (`{ id, label, group, deps, timeoutMs, run, describe }`) — **not a single line of the assembly flow changes**. A downstream plugin can also call `registerSource()` at runtime to hang its own health shard into this panel (the fixtures verify exactly that).

There is no second dashboard.

@kira905/dsh-ecosystem-panel README · 7. Known limitations：1. **`js-yaml` is provided by the host** — when it cannot be resolved, classes ② and ④ show "not parseable" (no false green), but that also means they cannot be checked.
2. **The boot manifest is fetched from the host home page**, from the inline `__DSH_BOOT__` block — if the host changes that projection, ①'s "load state" becomes unknown (yellow).
3. **③'s verdict depends entirely on the manifest you supply**: this repository **embeds no patch manifest** for any environment, so a wrong manifest produces wrong reports.
4. **⑤'s colour does not come from this panel**: it comes from the tier CLI you configure (the single source of judgement). The panel only renders it and never guesses a colour.
5. **⑥⑦ depend on external scripts**, which this repository does not ship; when they are not configured the corresponding classes only show a degradation notice.
6. **The upgrade check reaches the npm registry** (`registry.npmjs.org`) and caches its result for 24 h; when offline it shows "remote lookup failed" and keeps using the cache.
7. **Read-only**: the panel has no write entry point at all (the only file it writes is the upgrade
